visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Xiao Kui is seen in a selfie-style eye-level shot inside a car. She wears a pink knitted beanie and a light purple sweater with her hair in two braids. She speaks with high energy, frequent eye contact with the camera, and active facial expressions. (2) The scene shifts to a brightly lit indoor workshop. Xiao Kui is standing with another female staff member wearing a mask and beige sweater. They are positioned next to a white SUV. They use hand gestures to explain the car wrapping process. (3) Behind the white SUV, Xiao Kui continues her narration. Close-up shots capture her acting dramatic and emotional. A small circular overlay of a man's face appears briefly with text. (4) A fast-paced editing montage shows several male workers in a garage. They are cleaning the car and applying white vinyl film to the body and hood. Graphic overlays such as 'LEVEL UP!' appear during this process. (5) In the final phase, Xiao Kui returns to the screen in the workshop, reacting with immense joy to the finished white wrap. She touches the car's hood and front fender to demonstrate the smooth texture under bright studio lighting.
